card_purpose: Control experiment for the AI-capex question blocking GOOGL(O1/O2), AMZN(O4), META(O4), MSFT(O2). Primary output is the observable-sequence checklist, not the ORCL trade verdict.
as_of_price_basis: 2026-08-06 settled close. 2026-08-07 was still trading at write time (13:45 ET, intraday 144.88, range 142.34-147.16) so it was NOT used.

verdicts.business_verdict_note: A good legacy franchise (database/software) fused to an unproven one (renting AI compute). The unproven half now absorbs 100% of marginal capital.
verdicts.conditional_max_size_condition: price <= ~$101 AND K-A (counterparty credit) turns green. Cap is 2% not 3% because a genuine permanent-capital-loss path exists.
verdicts.verdict_ceiling_rule: completeness 58% falls in the 40-60% band -> ceiling WATCH (audit.md). Verdict does NOT exceed ceiling.
verdicts.binding_constraint: COUNTERPARTY CONCENTRATION + FUNDING GAP (primary); price/no-MOS (secondary, base IRR +6.2% < 8%). Unlike GOOGL/AMZN, price is NOT the main blocker here.

M1_evidence_spine.note: Q4 FY2026 8-K full P&L captured incl. interest $4,599M and preferred dividends $103M; SEC direct fetch 403, 10-K line items not read -> capped.

M2_theme_mechanism.note: Demand side is real: RPO $638B +363%, OCI +93%, GPU utilization 97.5%, Multicloud DB +404%. First half of mechanism proven; second half (converting to cash) has zero evidence.

M3_profit_pool.note: Consolidated ROIC 15.11% -> 11.24%, directly contradicting management's 'high 20s' incremental claim. Renting compute is not an exclusive bottleneck: #4 hyperscaler with the weakest balance sheet. Gross margin -4.69pp.

M4_financial_reality.note: FCF -$23.7B; capex/OCF 174%; net debt $124.3B (+33.8%); Debt/EBITDA 5.22x; interest = 22.3% of EBIT; buybacks reversed to net issuance; preferred issued; S&P cut to BBB-.

M5_inversion_trap.note: STRUCTURAL DIFFERENCE vs GOOGL/AMZN: leverage + single counterparty = a real permanent-capital-loss path, not merely a de-rating. Bear IRR -8.9% carrying $124B net debt.

M6_price_position.note: After -55.8%, price is the LEAST bad module: base IRR +6.2% (1.8pp short of hurdle), bull +15.2% genuinely pays. But base still fails.

module_signals.vs_googl_2026_07_24: GOOGL was +1/+2/+1/-2/-1/-2. ORCL's M6 is better (price already fell), M3/M5 worse (returns deteriorating + leverage). This is the difference between the late-stage and mid-stage form of the same bet.

bear.basis: FY2026 pretax $19.55B at normalized 19% tax = $15.8B, less (a) D&A converging toward true fleet replacement (~$18B vs today's $9.3B) and (b) interest run-rate rising $4.6B -> ~$7B.

base.basis: FY2026 GAAP net income to common $16,984M, marked down to a normalized 19% tax rate (actual effective rate only 12.6%), with a modest depreciation-catch-up adjustment.

bull.basis: OCF $32.0B - D&A $9.3B, i.e. the cash framing management implies, treating all $46.3B of incremental capex as pure growth investment.

scenarios.anchor_sensitivity: OE0 spans 2.1x ($11B-$23B) and the spread is driven almost entirely by ONE undisclosed number: the maintenance-vs-growth capex split (O5). If maintenance capex really is D&A ($9.3B), base IRR rises to ~+9% and CLEARS the hurdle. If it is $25B (steady-state six-year fleet replacement), base IRR falls to ~+2%. This is the identical number blocking GOOGL O1 and AMZN O4.

price_ladder.ladder_is_not_auto_executing: Unlike other cards in this library, $121.50 does not auto-promote to STARTER. >50% of RPO sits with a counterparty whose own FCF is deeply negative; a lower price does not remove that risk, it changes whether the base case exists at all. Close O1 first.

K-A.test: Counterparty credit: OpenAI (or any >$50B counterparty) renegotiates/defers/cancels, or its own funding falters
K-A.note: Oracle never names OpenAI in a filing; OpenAI financials not obtained this run. HIGHEST PRIORITY, see O1.

K-B.test: Funding gap: FY2027 FOCF deficit reaches S&P's -$42B, or financing exceeds the $40B plan
K-B.note: FY2026 already -$23.7B; guided path leads to -$42B.

K-C.test: Capital-allocation discipline: capex ROI hurdle / maintenance-growth split still undisclosed; or management keeps using 'add back depreciation / divide by gross investment'
K-C.note: All three undisclosed and the ROIC definition is non-standard.

K-D.test: Rating falls below BBB- into speculative grade -> nonlinear funding-cost repricing and forced selling
K-D.note: S&P BBB- as of 2026-07-09; Moody's Baa2 outlook negative. One notch away.

K-E.test: Unit economics: gross margin keeps falling with OCI utilization peaking (<95%), or consolidated ROIC drops another >2pp
K-E.note: FY26 GM -4.69pp, ROIC -3.87pp; management already guided another FY2027 step-down.

K-F.test: Backlog quality: RPO declines in absolute terms, or cancellations/removals disclosed
K-F.note: Q4 still +$85B sequential, though Q3 decelerated to +$30B.

K-G.test: No-chase: price back above ~$150 without a fundamental upgrade

K-H.test: UPGRADE trigger: price below ~$101 AND K-A green

feedback_checklist_capex_bet_failure.title: 回喂：capex 豪赌失败的可观测序列
counterintuitive_findings: FCF turning negative is NOT the trigger. Oracle's FCF went negative in FY2025, 3.4 months BEFORE the share-price peak, and the market then added another ~+90%. Do not use it to time.

The real turn is FUNDING MIX, not cash flow. Sequence: self-funded -> debt -> equity/preferred -> downgrade. 'Starts issuing equity' is the single strongest signal (ORCL 2026-02, leading the downgrade by 5 months and the low by 5.5 months).

'Good news met with a negative reaction' is a same-day regime-change signal. On 2026-06-10 revenue, EPS and RPO all beat and the stock fell 7-10% after hours. The market's objective function switched from growth to funding, observable in one session.

extrapolation_caveat.note: GOOGL/META/MSFT are NOT on the leverage branch today - their capex is self-funded from operating cash flow with no BBB- constraint. AMZN sits in between (levered, but coverage far higher).
extrapolation_caveat.transferable_note: These kill the MULTIPLE and cause de-rating. GOOGL's K-B is already RED FIRING and its M4 has moved -1 -> -2 along exactly this path.
extrapolation_caveat.not_transferable: The timing after C1/C2 fire, and the DEPTH of the bear case. ORCL's bear is -8.9% carrying $124B of net debt (permanent loss). GOOGL/META/MSFT's bear is multiple reversion, not capital-structure rupture. Same mechanism, different floor.
extrapolation_caveat.single_most_important_watch: C7. Before it, 'reinvestment' is a story; after it, 'dilution' is a fact. None of the four has crossed C7 yet. Re-read this card the day one of them does.

derating_vs_impairment.question: Is the -55.8% a de-rating of the multiple or an impairment of the business?
derating_vs_impairment.reconciliation: 0.3290 x 1.3433 = 0.4420 -> -55.80%, exactly matching the price move.
derating_vs_impairment.answer_layer_1: On earnings LEVEL, 100% of the decline is multiple de-rating. EPS did not fall - it rose 34%.
derating_vs_impairment.answer_layer_2: But the de-rating was CAUSED by an impairment of earnings QUALITY: gross margin -4.69pp, ROIC -3.87pp, FCF -$0.4B -> -$23.7B, rating cut to BBB-. The market did not cut 'how much they earn'; it cut 'what those earnings are worth per unit'.
derating_vs_impairment.answer_layer_3: Leverage amplified the gap: EV fell from ~$1,023.6B to ~$537.5B (-47.5%) while equity fell -55.80%. The 8.3pp difference is net debt ($92.9B -> $124.3B) absorbing enterprise value. Enterprise value fell less than half; shareholders lost more than half.
derating_vs_impairment.unfinished_exam: The earnings-LEVEL test has not happened yet. OpenAI revenue does not begin until FY2028. Today's 24.6x sits on FY2026 EPS, which contains almost none of the AI contract revenue but already carries all of the interest and depreciation.
